source: Static analysis of reverse-engineered/decompiled/60E15120_N3J1E + reverse-engineered/disassembly/60E15120_N3J1E/firmware_disassembly.asm + raw ROM bytes (submodules/Mazda_RX8_PCM_ReverseEngineering/Stock_ROMs/60E15120_N3J1E.bin, SHA-256 a7cd953c2a87af12ee2814a95c958dc23959d352ef9c5e7f82b8ab8952f264f1). Report: can_mailbox_config_report.md.

0002a4f8.evidence: Compares a desired HCAN mailbox descriptor array (param_2: 16 x 16-byte records for channel 0, 6 for channel 1) against live registers: HCAN0_BCR_W 0xffffe402 / HCAN1_BCR_W 0xffffe602 expect 0x803e; MBCR/MBIMR rebuilt from record bytes and compared (HCAN0_MBCR_W 0xffffe404, HCAN0_MBIMR_W 0xffffe414, HCAN1_MBCR_W 0xffffe604, HCAN1_MBIMR_W 0xffffe614); HCAN0_IMR_W 0xffffe416 / HCAN1_IMR_W 0xffffe616 expect 0xfcfe; HCAN0_LAFMH_W 0xffffe41e + HCAN0_LAFML_W 0xffffe41c (and HCAN1_LAFMH_W 0xffffe61e / HCAN1_LAFML_W 0xffffe61c) must be zero; per-mailbox MC control/data bytes checked at HCAN0_MC0[1]_B 0xffffe420 + 8*(mb&0xf) (MC0[5]/MC0[6]/MC0[7]/MC0[8] hold ID/DLC fields). Returns nonzero on any mismatch. Called from ref_canSetup 0xd9f4 (jsr @r13 at 0xda3e/0xda4e; pool 0xdb20 = 0x2a4f8) in a <=2-iteration retry loop with ref_CANControllerSetup(0, 0x4e01c or 0x4e11c, 0x10) and (1, 0x4e21c, 6); after >1 tries sets error flag 0xffffa410. Record-field mapping verified against the writer chain (ref_CANControllerSetup 0x9744 -> ref_setCANRegisters 0xcacc -> ref_initializeCANRegisters 0x9d24) and the compare loop (0x2a56e-0x2a5be: mov.b @(0x4,r9) accumulates MBCR, mov.b @(0xc,r9) accumulates MBIMR): +0..+3 u32 BE = CAN id, +4 = MBCR direction bit (0=TX, 1=RX per Sh7055h.pdf 16.2.4), +5 = mailbox number, +6 = MC control/DLC byte, +7 = IDE flag, +8..+11 = RAM data buffer pointer (not consumed by setup), +12 = MBIMR interrupt-mask bit (0 = interrupt enabled, 1 = disabled per Sh7055h.pdf 16.2.12), +13..+15 = zero in all ROM blocks. Register bit for mailbox mb is 1<<((mb+8)&0xf) in MBCR/MBIMR.

0000dade.evidence: bsr ref_canSetup 0xd9f4 at 0xdae0, then ref_resetCANTimers 0xda94; called only from ref_checkCANsomethingKeyOnBased 0xdcc0 via bsr at 0xdda8 when error counter 0xffffa40c >= 1000 (cmp/ge 0x3e8, pool 0xddc6) - full CAN reset after a persistent bus-off/error condition.

0002a248.evidence: sh_raise_interrupt_mask_return_previous(0x10), then ref_checkCANsomethingKeyOnBased 0xdcc0 (jsr @r3 at 0x2a252, pool 0x2a44c = 0xdcc0), then FUN_000547d8, then ref_setSR restores the mask; called from FUN_000114b0 0x114b0 (jsr at 0x114b8, pool 0x11680 = 0x2a248), which is called from OS task 7 entry ref_interruptSetup___ 0x63f0 (task-table record 7 at 0x4a08 = 0x63f0; jsr at 0x6414, pool 0x6528 = 0x114b0).

00009ac4.evidence: returns (HCANx_GSR_B & 1) != 0 for channel param_1 (HCAN0_GSR_B 0xffffe401 / HCAN1_GSR_B 0xffffe601; GSR bit0 = bus-off flag, REC >= 256, per Sh7055h.pdf 16.2.2); called from 0xdcc0 via pool 0xddd4 = 0x9ac4 (jsr at 0xdd4e/0xdd5c).

00028eb8.evidence: Reads RX buffer 0xffffbab8 (pool 0x28fc8): bytes 0-1, 2-3, 5-6 assembled big-endian into u16 cells 0xffffbad4/bad6/bad8 (pools 0x28fcc/0x28fd0/0x28fd8), bytes 4 and 7 stored as u8 at 0xffffbada/badc. Three words + two bytes, not eight raw bytes. Re-verified this pass.

000291dc.evidence: Packs 8 bytes into 0xffffbaf4 (pool 0x292a4): u16 0xffffbafc (rpm) at +0/+1, u16 0xffffbafe at +2/+3, u16 0xffffbb00 (speed) at +4/+5, bytes from 0xffffbb02/bb03 at +6/+7, then jmp 0x99b0 queue (pool 0x292bc). CAN 0x201 descriptor at ROM 0x4df1c = 0000 0201 0001 0800 ffffbaf4 0100 0000 (BE id 0x201, len 8, buffer 0xffffbaf4) - ROM bytes re-read this pass.

00029236.evidence: Fault flag byte 0xffffcdbc (pool 0x29294) == 1 -> sentinel 0xffff (u32 pool 0x292c0); else float input 0xffffbb04 (pool 0x292c8) converted via helper 0x2490 with scale 0.25 (float const at 0x292c4) RPM/count, capped at 0xfffe (u32 pool 0x29298), written to 0xffffbafc (pool 0x292a0). Re-verified this pass.

0002927c.evidence: Same shape as 0x29236: fault -> 0xffff sentinel (u32 pool 0x292c0), else input 0xffffbbbb (pool 0x29296) scaled (speed+100)/0.01, normal cap 40000, written to 0xffffbb00 (pool 0x292ac). Re-verified this pass.

00029340.evidence: Reads engine rpm 0xffffb548 (pool 0x293c2), runs conditional filter (helper 0x23dc, pool 0x293f4) gated on flag bytes 0xffffa428/0xffffaa62 (pools 0x293c4/0x293c6), stores result 0xffffbb04 and previous unfiltered value 0xffffbb08. Re-verified this pass.

ffffbaf4.evidence: 8-byte CAN 0x201 TX buffer; descriptor at ROM 0x4df1c points here (bytes re-read this pass).

ffffbafc.evidence: 0.25 RPM/count from 0xffffbb04, cap 0xfffe, 0xffff fault sentinel; packed at payload +0/+1 by 0x291dc.

ffffbb00.evidence: (speed+100)/0.01 from 0xffffbbbb, normal cap 40000, 0xffff fault; packed at payload +4/+5 by 0x291dc.

ffffbb04.evidence: Conditionally filtered rpm from 0xffffb548; input to 0x29236 encoder.

ffffbb08.evidence: Previous unfiltered rpm saved each call by 0x29340.

ffffa409.evidence: Set to 1 in the bus-off/error branch of 0xdcc0 (mov.b r11,@r3 at 0xdd78, pool 0xddc4 = 0xa409).

ffffa40a.evidence: Set when error-poll counter 0xffffa40f exceeds 100 (mov #0x64 at 0xdd16, cmp/gt; pool 0xddc2 = 0xa40a) and the latch was 0; cleared after the 0xdade full reset.

ffffa40c.evidence: Incremented via rx8_add_u16_saturate 0x2460 (pool 0xddd8) each error poll; ref_canSetup is re-run only while it is 0 (tst at 0xdd7c); full reset 0xdade when it reaches 1000 (pool 0xddc6 = 0x3e8). Cell at pool 0xddd0.

ffffa40e.evidence: Retry-loop counter of ref_canSetup 0xd9f4 (pool 0xdb10 = 0xffffa40e; incremented at 0xda5c-0xda60, loop bound 2 at 0xda06).

ffffa40f.evidence: Saturating counter (cap 0xff, pool 0xddc0) incremented while engine running (0xffffaa68==1) and ref_getHCANSomething 0x9b08 (GSR bit1 error warning) is set on either channel; cleared otherwise.

ffffa410.evidence: Set to 1 by ref_canSetup 0xd9f4 when the <=2-iteration mailbox-config retry loop still mismatches; 0xffffa411 cleared after the loop.
